qe: A man sells a cow for ₹22,000 and gains 10%. At what price should he sell the same cow, in order to gain 14%?
qh: एक व्यक्ति एक गाय को ₹22,000 में बेचता है और 10% का लाभ प्राप्त करता है। 14% का लाभ प्राप्त करने के लिए उसे उसी गाय को किस मूल्य पर बेचना चाहिए?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
SP1 : SP2 = (100 + 10) : (100 + 14) = 110 : 114 = 55 : 57
55 units = 22,000 ==> 1 unit = 400
SP2 = 57 units = 57 * 400 = ₹22,800.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹22,800 hai.

Method 2 (Unitary Percentage Method):
110% = 22,000
1% = 200
114% = 114 * 200 = ₹22,800.
Atah sahi uttar '₹22,800' hai.

Yahan diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan seedha lagta hai. She sh vikalp ₹23,000, ₹23,800, ₹22,900 is hisaab se nahi milte. Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - yahi short tarika pariksha mein kaam aata hai.

qe: By selling an article for ₹2,200, a profit of 10% is earned. If the same article is sold for ₹2,600, then what will be the gain percentage?
qh: किसी वस्तु को ₹2,200 में बेचने पर 10% का लाभ प्राप्त होता है। यदि उसी वस्तु को ₹2,600 में बेचा जाए, तो लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
10% profit = 1/10 ==> CP : SP1 = 10 : 11
11 units = 2200 ==> 1 unit = 200
CP = 10 units = 2000
Now, CP : SP2 = 2000 : 2600 = 10 : 13
Profit = 13 - 10 = 3 units
Profit% = (3 / 10) * 100% = 30%.
Atah sahi vikalp  30% hai.

Method 2 (Direct Value to % Scaling):
₹2200 = 110%
₹1 = (110 / 2200)% = 1/20%
₹2600 = 2600 * (1/20)% = 130%
Profit% = 130% - 100% = 30%.
Atah sahi uttar '30%' hai.

Yahan labh-haani ka niyam seedha lagta hai. She sh vikalp 20%, 15%, 37% is hisaab se nahi milte. Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - yahi short tarika pariksha mein kaam aata hai.

qe: A man loses 28% by selling an article for ₹144. If he sells it for ₹288, what will be his gain/loss percentage?
qh: एक व्यक्ति को एक वस्तु ₹144 में बेचने पर 28% की हानि होती है। यदि वह इसे ₹288 में बेचता है, तो उसका लाभ/हानि प्रतिशत क्या होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
28% loss = 7/25 ==> CP : SP1 = 25 : 18
18 units = 144 ==> 1 unit = 8
CP = 25 * 8 = 200
Now, CP : SP2 = 200 : 288 = 25 : 36
Profit = 36 - 25 = 11 units
Profit% = (11 / 25) * 100% = 44% Gain.
Atah sahi vikalp  Gain, 44% hai.

Method 2 (Direct Percentage Scaling):
SP1 = 100% - 28% = 72%
₹144 = 72%
Since SP2 = ₹288 (double of ₹144):
SP2% = 72% * 2 = 144%
Profit% = 144% - 100% = 44% Gain.
Atah sahi uttar 'Gain, 44%' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A pen was sold for ₹166.44 with a profit of 14%. If it were sold for ₹154.76, then what would have been the percentage of profit or loss?
qh: एक पेन ₹166.44 में 14% के लाभ पर बेचा गया। यदि इसे ₹154.76 में बेचा जाता, तो लाभ या हानि का प्रतिशत क्या होता?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
14% profit = 7/50 ==> CP : SP1 = 50 : 57
57 units = 166.44 ==> 1 unit = 2.92
CP = 50 * 2.92 = 146
Now, CP : SP2 = 146 : 154.76 = 14600 : 15476 = 50 : 53
Profit = 53 - 50 = 3 units
Profit% = (3 / 50) * 100% = 6% profit.
Atah sahi vikalp  6% profit hai.

Method 2 (Unitary Percentage Method):
₹166.44 = 114%
₹154.76 = (114 / 166.44) * 154.76 = 106%
Profit% = 106% - 100% = 6% profit.
Atah sahi uttar '6% profit' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If I gain 124% by selling an item for ₹1,232, then what would be my gain or loss percentage if I sell it for ₹572?
qh: यदि किसी वस्तु को ₹1,232 में बेचने पर मुझे 124% का लाभ होता है, तो यदि मैं इसे ₹572 में बेचता हूँ तो मेरा लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत क्या होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
SP1 : SP2 = 1232 : 572 = 28 : 13
SP1 represents (100 + 124)% = 224%
28 units = 224% ==> 1 unit = 8%
SP2 = 13 units = 13 * 8% = 104%
Gain% = 104% - 100% = 4% Gain.
Atah sahi vikalp  4% Gain hai.

Method 2 (Direct Fractional CP Method):
CP = 1232 * (100 / 224) = 550
Gain = 572 - 550 = 22
Gain% = (22 / 550) * 100% = 4% Gain.
Atah sahi uttar '4% Gain' hai.

Yahan labh-haani ka niyam seedha lagta hai. Vikalp 6% Gain, 6% Loss, 4% Loss is hal se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - yahi short tarika pariksha mein kaam aata hai.

qe: A seller decreased the selling price of each item from ₹5,000 to ₹4,680, by which his loss percentage increased by 4%. If he has to get 4% profit, then the selling price of the item should be:
qh: एक विक्रेता ने प्रत्येक वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य ₹5,000 से घटाकर ₹4,680 कर दिया, जिससे उसका हानि प्रतिशत 4% बढ़ गया। यदि उसे 4% लाभ प्राप्त करना है, तो वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य होना चाहिए:
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Difference in SP = 5000 - 4680 = 320
Change in % : Required SP% = 4% : (100 + 4)% = 4 : 104 = 1 : 26
1 unit = 320
Required SP = 26 units = 26 * 320 = ₹8,320.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹8,320 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
4% of CP = 320 ==> 1% = 80
CP (100%) = 8,000
SP at 4% profit = 8000 * 1.04 = ₹8,320.
Atah sahi uttar '₹8,320' hai.

Yahan labh-haani ka niyam seedha lagta hai. Vikalp ₹7,280, ₹7,800, ₹8,840 is hal se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - yahi short tarika pariksha mein kaam aata hai.

qe: Samreen sells a keyboard for ₹1,260 at a profit of 25%, and another keyboard for ₹1,440 at a loss of 10%. What is her total gain or loss:
qh: समरीन एक कीबोर्ड ₹1,260 में 25% के लाभ पर बेचती है, और दूसरा कीबोर्ड ₹1,440 में 10% की हानि पर बेचती है। उसका कुल लाभ या हानि क्या है:
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Item 1 (25% profit = 1/4): CP : SP = 4 : 5
5 units = 1260 ==> 1 unit = 252 ==> CP1 = 4 * 252 = 1008
Item 2 (10% loss = 1/10): CP : SP = 10 : 9
9 units = 1440 ==> 1 unit = 160 ==> CP2 = 10 * 160 = 1600
Total CP = 1008 + 1600 = 2608
Total SP = 1260 + 1440 = 2700
Profit = 2700 - 2608 = 92
Profit% = (92 / 2608) * 100% = (23 / 652) * 100% = 575/163% = 3$\frac{86}{163}$% Gain.
Atah sahi vikalp  3$\frac{86}{163}$% Gain hai.

Method 2 (Direct Profit/Loss Balance Method):
Profit 1 = 1260 * (1/5) = +252
Loss 2 = 1440 * (1/9) = -160
Net Profit = 252 - 160 = +92
Total CP = (1260 - 252) + (1440 + 160) = 1008 + 1600 = 2608
Gain% = (92 / 2608) * 100% = 3$\frac{86}{163}$% Gain.
Atah sahi uttar '3$\frac{86}{163}$% Gain' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A mobile phone dealer buys a phone for ₹10,000 and sells it for ₹12,000. Later, he realizes that he could have sold it for ₹13,000. What is the percentage loss that he incurs?
qh: एक मोबाइल फोन डीलर ₹10,000 में एक फोन खरीदता है और इसे ₹12,000 में बेचता है। बाद में, उसे एहसास होता है कि वह इसे ₹13,000 में बेच सकता था। उसे कितने प्रतिशत की हानि हुई?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
CP : SP : New SP = 10,000 : 12,000 : 13,000
Loss = 13,000 - 12,000 = 1,000
Loss% = (1,000 / 10,000) * 100% = 10%.
Atah sahi vikalp  10% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
CP = 100
SP = 120, New SP = 130
Difference = 130 - 120 = 10
Loss% = 10%.
Atah sahi uttar '10%' hai.

Is prashn ka moolaadhaar labh-haani ka niyam hai. She sh vikalp 20%, 15%, 25% is hisaab se nahi milte. Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - yahi short tarika pariksha mein kaam aata hai.

qe: Manjeet bought a second-hand motorbike for ₹22,000 and spent ₹3,000 on its overhauling and maintenance. He then sold it with 12% profit. If he had sold it for ₹500 less, then what would have been his profit percentage?
qh: मनजीत ने ₹22,000 में एक पुरानी मोटरबाइक खरीदी और उसकी मरम्मत और रखरखाव पर ₹3,000 खर्च किए। फिर उसने इसे 12% लाभ पर बेच दिया। यदि उसने इसे ₹500 कम में बेचा होता, तो उसका लाभ प्रतिशत क्या होता?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
12% = +3/25
Total CP = 22000 + 3000 = ₹25,000
CP : SP = 25 : 28
25 -> (x1000) -> 25000
28 -> (x1000) -> 28000
When sold at ₹500 less: New SP = 28000 - 500 = ₹27,500
New CP : New SP = 25000 : 27500 = 10 : 11
Profit% = (1 / 10) * 100% = 10%.
Atah sahi vikalp  10% hai.

Method 2 (Percentage Shift Method):
Total CP = ₹25,000
500 as % of CP = (500 / 25000) * 100% = 2%
New Profit% = 12% - 2% = 10%.
Atah sahi uttar '10%' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A merchant sells 195 kg of wheat for ₹10,260 at a profit of ₹4.50 per kg of wheat. What is the cost price (in ₹, to the nearest integer) of 15 kg of wheat?
qh: एक व्यापारी 195 किग्रा गेहूं ₹10,260 में ₹4.50 प्रति किग्रा के लाभ पर बेचता है। 15 किग्रा गेहूं का क्रय मूल्य (₹ में, निकटतम पूर्णांक तक) क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Quantity ratio = 15 : 195 = 1 : 13
SP of 15 kg = 10260 / 13 = ₹789.23
Profit on 15 kg = 15 * 4.50 = ₹67.50
CP of 15 kg = 789.23 - 67.50 = ₹721.73 ≈ ₹722.
Atah sahi vikalp  722 hai.

Method 2 (Per Unit Method):
SP per kg = 10260 / 195 = ₹52.615
CP per kg = 52.615 - 4.50 = ₹48.115
CP of 15 kg = 15 * 48.115 ≈ ₹721.73 ≈ ₹722.
Atah sahi uttar '722' hai.

Yahan labh-haani ka niyam seedha lagta hai. Vikalp 682, 595, 750 is hal se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - yahi short tarika pariksha mein kaam aata hai.

qe: A shopkeeper bought 288 oranges for ₹115.20. He sold 50 of them at 70 paise each and the remaining at ₹46.20. Find his profit or loss.
qh: एक दुकानदार ने ₹115.20 में 288 संतरे खरीदे। उसने उनमें से 50 संतरे 70 पैसे प्रति संतरे की दर से बेचे और शेष संतरे ₹46.20 में बेचे। उसका लाभ या हानि ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
CP = ₹115.20
SP1 = 50 * 0.70 = ₹35
Total SP = 35 + 46.20 = ₹81.20
CP : SP = 115.20 : 81.20 = 288 : 203
Loss in units = 288 - 203 = 85 units
Since 288 units = ₹115.20 ==> 1 unit = ₹0.40
Loss = 85 * 0.40 = ₹34.
Atah sahi vikalp  Loss, ₹34 hai.

Method 2 (Direct Value Subtraction Method):
Total SP = (50 * 0.70) + 46.20 = ₹81.20
Loss = CP - SP = 115.20 - 81.20 = ₹34.
Atah sahi uttar 'Loss, ₹34' hai.

Is prashn ka moolaadhaar labh-haani ka niyam hai. Vikalp Profit, ₹25, Profit, ₹37, Loss, ₹36 is hal se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - yahi short tarika pariksha mein kaam aata hai.

qe: A shopkeeper buys 1800 kg wheat for ₹32,400. If 20% of this wheat is spoiled due to rain, at what rate (₹/kg) should he sell the rest to earn 20%?
qh: एक दुकानदार ₹32,400 में 1800 किग्रा गेहूं खरीदता है। यदि बारिश के कारण इसमें से 20% गेहूं खराब हो जाता है, तो 20% लाभ कमाने के लिए उसे शेष गेहूं को किस दर (₹/किग्रा) पर बेचना चाहिए?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
CP per kg = 32400 / 1800 = ₹18/kg
Usable quantity ratio = 80% = 4/5
Target revenue ratio = 120% = 6/5
Price multiplier = (6/5) / (4/5) = 6/4 = 3/2
Selling rate = 18 * (3/2) = ₹27/kg.
Atah sahi vikalp  27 hai.

Method 2 (Total SP to Usable Quantity Method):
Total required SP = 32400 * 1.20 = ₹38,880
Usable wheat = 1800 * 0.80 = 1440 kg
Selling rate = 38880 / 1440 = ₹27/kg.
Atah sahi uttar '27' hai.

Is prashn ka moolaadhaar diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan hai. Vikalp 29, 26, 25 is hal se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein, samay bachega.

qe: A trader buys 500 kg cotton for ₹8,000. If 10% of this cotton is spoiled due to rain, at what rate (₹/kg) should he sell the rest to earn a 20% profit?
qh: एक व्यापारी ₹8,000 में 500 किग्रा कपास खरीदता है। यदि बारिश के कारण इसमें से 10% कपास खराब हो जाती है, तो 20% लाभ कमाने के लिए उसे शेष कपास को किस दर (₹/किग्रा) पर बेचना चाहिए?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
CP per kg = 8000 / 500 = ₹16/kg
Available quantity ratio = 90% = 9/10
Target revenue ratio = 120% = 6/5
Selling multiplier = (6/5) / (9/10) = 4/3
Rate per kg = 16 * (4/3) = 64/3 = 21$\frac{1}{3}$ ₹/kg.
Atah sahi vikalp  21 1/3 hai.

Method 2 (Total SP to Usable Quantity Method):
Total required SP = 8000 * 1.20 = ₹9,600
Usable cotton = 500 * 0.90 = 450 kg
Rate per kg = 9600 / 450 = 64/3 = 21$\frac{1}{3}$ ₹/kg.
Atah sahi uttar '21$\frac{1}{3}$' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A retailer purchased a batch of goods for ₹5,000. Due to a manufacturing defect, 5% of the goods were damaged. If the retailer wants to make a profit of 20% on the remaining goods, at what price should the undamaged goods be sold?
qh: एक खुदरा विक्रेता ने ₹5,000 में सामान का एक बैच खरीदा। निर्माण दोष के कारण, 5% सामान क्षतिग्रस्त हो गया। यदि खुदरा विक्रेता शेष सामान पर 20% का लाभ कमाना चाहता है, तो बिना क्षतिग्रस्त सामान को किस मूल्य पर बेचा जाना चाहिए?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Total goods ratio = 20 : 19
Cost of undamaged goods = 5000 * (19 / 20) = ₹4,750
20% profit = 1/5 ==> CP : SP = 5 : 6
5 units = 4750 ==> 1 unit = 950
SP = 6 units = 6 * 950 = ₹5,700.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹5,700 hai.

Method 2 (Direct Multiplier Method):
SP = 5000 * (1 - 0.05) * (1 + 0.20) = 5000 * 0.95 * 1.20 = ₹5,700.
Atah sahi uttar '₹5,700' hai.

Is prashn ka moolaadhaar labh-haani ka niyam hai. She sh vikalp ₹5,800, ₹6,000, ₹5,900 is hisaab se nahi milte. Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - yahi short tarika pariksha mein kaam aata hai.

qe: A grocer purchased 10 kg rice for ₹700. He spends some amount on transportation and then sells it for ₹1,400. If the percentage of profit made by the grocer is 30%, then what is the amount (in ₹) he spends on transportation? (Round off to the nearest integer)
qh: एक पंसारी ने ₹700 में 10 किग्रा चावल खरीदा। वह परिवहन पर कुछ राशि खर्च करता है और फिर इसे ₹1,400 में बेचता है। यदि पंसारी द्वारा अर्जित लाभ का प्रतिशत 30% है, तो वह परिवहन पर कितनी राशि (₹ में) खर्च करता है? (निकटतम पूर्णांक तक पूर्णांकित)
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
30% profit = 3/10 ==> Total CP : SP = 10 : 13
13 units = 1400 ==> 1 unit = 1400 / 13
Total CP = 10 units = (1400 / 13) * 10 = 14000 / 13 ≈ ₹1,076.92
Transportation cost = Total CP - Rice cost = 1076.92 - 700 = ₹376.92 ≈ ₹377.
Atah sahi vikalp  ₹377 hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
SP = 130% = 1400
1% = 1400 / 130
Total CP (100%) = (1400 / 130) * 100 ≈ ₹1,076.92
Transportation = 1076.92 - 700 ≈ ₹377.
Atah sahi uttar '₹377' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A vendor buys 20 laptop bags for ₹13,000 and sells them at 15 for ₹10,125. How many laptop bags should be bought and sold to earn a profit of ₹3,225?
qh: एक विक्रेता ₹13,000 में 20 लैपटॉप बैग खरीदता है और उन्हें ₹10,125 में 15 की दर से बेचता है। ₹3,225 का लाभ कमाने के लिए कितने लैपटॉप बैग खरीदे और बेचे जाने चाहिए?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Let number of bags = LCM(20, 15) = 60 units.
CP of 60 bags = (13000 / 20) * 60 = 13000 * 3 = ₹39,000.
SP of 60 bags = (10125 / 15) * 60 = 10125 * 4 = ₹40,500.
CP : SP = 39000 : 40500 = 26 : 27.
Profit on 60 bags = 40,500 - 39,000 = ₹1,500.
Profit ratio to bags = 1500 : 60 = 25 : 1 (i.e., ₹25 profit on 1 bag).
Required number of bags for ₹3,225 profit = 3225 / 25 = 129.
Atah sahi vikalp  129 hai.

Method 2 (Per Unit Method):
CP per bag = 13000 / 20 = ₹650.
SP per bag = 10125 / 15 = ₹675.
Profit per bag = 675 - 650 = ₹25.
Number of bags = 3225 / 25 = 129.
Atah sahi uttar '129' hai.

Exam point: labh-haani ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A shopkeeper bought 95 dozen oranges at ₹4.50 each. 7 dozen oranges were rotten and so were discarded. He sold the remaining oranges at ₹78 per dozen. What is his profit or loss percent (to the nearest integer)?
qh: एक दुकानदार ने ₹4.50 प्रति संतरे की दर से 95 दर्जन संतरे खरीदे। 7 दर्जन संतरे सड़ गए और इसलिए उन्हें फेंक दिया गया। उसने शेष संतरे ₹78 प्रति दर्जन की दर से बेचे। उसका लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत (निकटतम पूर्णांक तक) क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
CP per dozen = 12 * 4.50 = ₹54.
Total CP = 95 * 54 = ₹5,130.
Remaining dozens = 95 - 7 = 88 dozen.
Total SP = 88 * 78 = ₹6,864.
Ratio CP : SP = 5130 : 6864 = 855 : 1144.
Profit = 1144 - 855 = 289 units.
Profit % = (289 / 855) * 100% = (1734 / 5130) * 100% = (1734 / 51.3)% ≈ 33.79% ≈ 34% Profit.
Atah sahi vikalp  Profit, 34% hai.
